# tenant-inactivity

tenant-inactivity: warn abandoned free accounts, then file the regular tenant-lifecycle deletion request; tier-based exemption and a keep-account link.

## README

# Sample: Tenant Inactivity

Opt-in deletion of abandoned free accounts. Mount `createTenantInactivityFeature` next to `sessions`, `tenant-lifecycle` and `delivery`; a daily job tracks the last activity per tenant, warns the tenant owners by mail and finally files the normal deletion request.

## What you learn here

- **One rule for everybody, or one per tier**: `{ rule }` applies to every tenant; `{ resolveTier, rulesByTier }` returns `null` for a tier to exempt it (paid plans).
- **Warning cycle**: with `warnings: [{ days: 30 }, { days: 7 }]` the owners get one mail 30 and one 7 days before the deadline. On the deadline the job calls the same core as the owner's `request-destruction` handler, so the wait period comes from the compliance profile and the owner can still cancel.
- **Activity restarts the cycle**: a new session counts, and so does the keep-account link in the mail (`keepAccountTokenSecret` signs it; without a secret the mail links to `keepAccountUrl` only). Other apps of the same account report through `activitySources`; `fetchRemoteAppLastActivity` reads the opt-in `lastActivityProbeSecret` route of a remote sessions feature.
- **No write per request**: the state is only written by the daily job; the state query (`tenant-inactivity:query:state`) shows `exempt`, `lastActivityAt`, `warningsSent`, `nextStep` and `nextStepAt`.

## Feature composition

```
sessions, tenant, tenant-lifecycle, delivery   (required)
tenant-inactivity  <- this sample
```

## Tests

`src/__tests__/feature.integration.test.ts` runs the job against a manual clock and reads the outlook through the state query. The full mail and deletion flow is covered in `bundled-features/src/tenant-inactivity/__tests__`.

### src/__tests__/feature.integration.test.ts

```ts
import { afterAll, beforeAll, describe, expect, test } from "bun:test";
import { createAuthEmailPasswordFeature } from "@cosmicdrift/kumiko-bundled-features/auth-email-password";
import { createAuthFoundationFeature } from "@cosmicdrift/kumiko-bundled-features/auth-foundation";
import { createComplianceProfilesFeature } from "@cosmicdrift/kumiko-bundled-features/compliance-profiles";
import {
  configValuesTable,
  createConfigFeature,
  createConfigResolver,
} from "@cosmicdrift/kumiko-bundled-features/config";
import {
  createDeliveryFeature,
  createDeliveryTestContext,
} from "@cosmicdrift/kumiko-bundled-features/delivery";
import {
  createSessionCallbacks,
  createSessionsFeature,
  type SessionCallbacks,
} from "@cosmicdrift/kumiko-bundled-features/sessions";
import {
  sessionCallbacksFromLateBound,
  withMintedSession,
} from "@cosmicdrift/kumiko-bundled-features/sessions/testing";
import { createTenantFeature, TenantHandlers } from "@cosmicdrift/kumiko-bundled-features/tenant";
import { createTenantInactivityFeature } from "@cosmicdrift/kumiko-bundled-features/tenant-inactivity";
import { createTenantLifecycleFeature } from "@cosmicdrift/kumiko-bundled-features/tenant-lifecycle";
import { createUserFeature } from "@cosmicdrift/kumiko-bundled-features/user";
import { SYSTEM_TENANT_ID } from "@cosmicdrift/kumiko-framework/engine";
import { TestUsers } from "@cosmicdrift/kumiko-framework/seeding";
import { createLateBoundHolder, createManualClock } from "@cosmicdrift/kumiko-testing/helpers";
import {
  setupTestStack,
  type TestStack,
  unsafePushTables,
} from "@cosmicdrift/kumiko-testing/stack";
import { Temporal } from "@cosmicdrift/kumiko-types/temporal";

const START = Temporal.Instant.from("2030-01-15T10:00:00Z");
const clock = createManualClock(START);
const callbacks = createLateBoundHolder<SessionCallbacks>("session-callbacks");

let stack: TestStack;

beforeAll(async () => {
  const bound = sessionCallbacksFromLateBound(callbacks);
  stack = await setupTestStack({
    features: [
      createConfigFeature(),
      createTenantFeature(),
      createUserFeature(),
      createComplianceProfilesFeature(),
      createDeliveryFeature(),
      createAuthFoundationFeature(),
      createAuthEmailPasswordFeature(),
      createSessionsFeature({ clock }),
      createTenantLifecycleFeature(),
      createTenantInactivityFeature({
        rule: { after: { months: 12 }, warnings: [{ days: 30 }, { days: 7 }] },
        keepAccountUrl: "https://app.example.test/keep-account",
      }),
    ],
    extraContext: (deps) => ({
      ...createDeliveryTestContext(deps),
      configResolver: createConfigResolver({ cipher: undefined }),
      clock,
    }),
    authConfig: { ...bound.asAuthConfig(), membershipQuery: "tenant:query:memberships" },
    jobs: { consumerLane: "worker" },
  });
  callbacks.set(createSessionCallbacks({ db: stack.db, clock }));
  await unsafePushTables(stack.db, { configValuesTable });
});

afterAll(async () => {
  await stack.cleanup();
});

describe("tenant-inactivity recipe", () => {
  test("the daily job plans the first warning from the last activity", async () => {
    const creator = sessionCallbacksFromLateBound(callbacks).asAuthConfig().sessionCreator;
    if (!creator) throw new Error("no sessionCreator");
    const systemAdmin = () =>
      withMintedSession(creator, { ...TestUsers.systemAdmin, tenantId: SYSTEM_TENANT_ID });
    await stack.http.writeOk(
      TenantHandlers.create,
      { id: TestUsers.admin.tenantId, key: "acme", name: "Acme Corp" },
      await systemAdmin(),
    );

    await stack.jobRunner?.dispatch("tenant-inactivity:job:check-inactive-tenants", {});
    await stack.drainJobs();

    const outlook = await stack.http.queryOk<Record<string, unknown>>(
      "tenant-inactivity:query:state",
      { tenantIdOverride: TestUsers.admin.tenantId },
      await systemAdmin(),
    );
    const deadline = START.toZonedDateTimeISO("UTC").add({ months: 12 }).toInstant();
    expect(outlook["exempt"]).toBe(false);
    expect(outlook["nextStep"]).toBe("warning");
    expect(outlook["nextStepAt"]).toBe(deadline.subtract({ hours: 30 * 24 }).toString());
  });
});
```
